jess_support: FYI — escalation from @aaron_customer. Customer's production calls to our function/tool calling API started failing ~20m ago after a model/tool catalog change. They say it's breaking the user flow. P2 for now. Error attached below.
aaron_customer: Hey team — sudden failures when I call our summarize tool. Used to work for months. Now getting 400s. Example response: 
```
HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request
{
  \"error\": {
    \"code\": \"TOOL_NOT_FOUND\",
    \"message\": \"Tool 'SummarizeText' not found. Available tools: [\"summarize-text\", \"translate\"]\"
  }
}
```
Requests are standard function call payloads. We didn't change clients.
jess_support: Can you paste the exact request body you used? Also which model and SDK? (curl or node snippet helps)
aaron_customer: Using server-side Node.js with our SDK wrapper. Minimal repro with curl: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example.com/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <KEY>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{
    \"model\": \"gpt-s-1\",
    \"input\": \"Summarize the following...\",
    \"tool_call\": {
      \"name\": \"SummarizeText\",
      \"args\": { \"max_length\": 200 }
    }
  }'
```
jess_support: Reproduced locally using the same request body -> same 400 TOOL_NOT_FOUND. Looks like the gateway is rejecting TitleCase tool names. @mike_sre can you check the catalog/registry logs? deploy-bot: deployment 2025-11-18T02:14:38Z: tool-registry-normalize-names v1.4.0 rolled to prod.
mike_sre: saw the alert. Quick summary: earlier today infra merged a change that normalizes tool/function identifiers in the registry to kebab-case (lowercase + dashes) during ingestion to standardize routing. The registry index now lists the canonical name as \"summarize-text\". There used to be alias entries but the alias-sync job failed in the last run (timeout) so TitleCase aliases didn't propagate. Logs show 503s to alias-sync for ~10m around the deployment window.
ingrid_engineer: Root cause: change #PR-4820 intended to normalize names on write only and keep backward-compatible alias mapping. However the alias-sync cron uses the batch-sync lambda and it timed out for the large customer catalog. That job cleans up the legacy aliases; because it timed out it left alias rows deleted but alias-recreate step never completed. So requests using legacy names now map to nothing -> TOOL_NOT_FOUND. Repro steps we used: 1) fetch registry entry: `GET https://registry.internal/v1/tools?summarize-text` -> returns canonical record. 2) check aliases: `GET https://registry.internal/v1/aliases?name=SummarizeText` -> returns empty. 3) run the legacy alias re-ingest locally and see alias row added, then gateway accepts TitleCase again.
sean_support_lead: Ok action plan: immediate mitigation for customer + medium term fix. Customer workaround: change tool name in request to \"summarize-text\". Can we provide a short snippet they can drop in their SDK to normalize until we fix server-side? Also need a hotfix on registry/gateway to accept case-insensitive mapping while we repair aliases.
ingrid_engineer: Patch plan: (1) Patch registry to temporarily accept case-insensitive lookups — quick 1-line change in the gateway routing (fallback to lowercase lookup if exact match fails). We'll push a canary to 10% traffic in the next 30m. (2) Re-run alias-sync with increased timeout and backfills for recently deleted aliases. (3) Add a one-off migration script to re-insert aliases for potentially impacted tools created before 2025-11-01. (4) Longer-term: introduce deterministic canonicalization and keep persistent alias mapping for 6 months post-rename.
mike_sre: I'm running the alias re-ingest now in a dry-run (`--dry-run` first). Command: `./tools/alias-sync --from-date 2020-01-01 --to-date now --timeout 120s --dry-run`. Dry-run shows ~1.2k aliases missing across customers, summarize-text is in that list. Starting real run now with 300s timeout.
deploy-bot: rollout started: registry-gateway v1.4.1 (case-insensitive lookup fallback) -> canary 10%.
jess_support: Sent workaround to @aaron_customer (quick client-side normalize helper and example payload). They verified it unblocks them. They prefer a server-side fix since many downstream clients are unmanaged.
aaron_customer: Confirmed workaround works for us. Thanks. We'd appreciate ETA on full fix and a writeup so we can update internal runbooks.
ingrid_engineer: Canary looks good so far (no errors in 10% bucket). Rolling to 50% now. After that we'll do full rollout. Alias re-ingest is at ~45% complete, no obvious failures. ETA for full resolution ~2.5 hours, but customer impact should be zero once the fallback is everywhere.
mike_sre: Postmortem items to capture: missing resilience in alias-sync job (timeouts), lack of end-to-end test for rename+alias preservation, and no observability for alias deletions during deployments. I'll open a postmortem ticket (SRE-312) and link this thread.
sean_support_lead: Thanks all. Action items for support: (A) Email affected customers we detect via logs (we have a list from dry-run) + suggested temporary SDK snippet. (B) Update status page if more customers show impact. (C) Follow up once migration completes with timeline and postmortem.
jess_support: I'll draft the customer communication once we confirm final rollout. For record: customer reported at 2025-11-18T02:12:14Z. Root cause appears to be registry rename + incomplete alias sync after deploy. Temporary fix applied (gateway fallback) and alias re-ingest in progress. Marking this thread resolved once migration completes and I confirm customer gets the final notification.
aaron_customer: Appreciate the fast response. Please CC me on the postmortem.

sean_support_lead: Tagging follow-up owners: ingrid_engineer (action: migration + gateway rollback plan), mike_sre (action: runback & postmortem), jess_support (action: customer comms).

jess_support: Closing notes: repro snippet for internal docs to add to KB: 
```
# failing (TitleCase)
curl https://api.redwood.example.com/v1/generate -d '{\"tool_call\":{\"name\":\"SummarizeText\"}}'
# working (kebab-case)
curl https://api.redwood.example.com/v1/generate -d '{\"tool_call\":{\"name\":\"summarize-text\"}}'
```
sean_support_lead: Thanks team. Will follow up on SRE-312 and attach logs.

ingrid_engineer: I'll post the final migration run output here once complete.

mike_sre: Migration finished at 1750424019. Verified alias rows inserted for summarize-text / SummarizeText. No further 400s for the customer after the change.

jess_support: Customer confirmed full resolution at 1750424032. Closing thread.
